name: caveman-browse
description: Token-efficient browser driver: compressed accessibility snapshots, uid actions, byte-exact recovery. Playwright MCP alternative.

interface.shortDescription: Drive Chrome with 4 compressed MCP tools. Byte-exact recovery.
interface.longDescription: Local browser driver for coding agents. Reads real Chrome accessibility trees, compresses them (savings always inferred), acts by uid handle, and recovers the byte-exact original payload on demand. One Go binary; attaches to the Chrome you already run.
defaultPrompt: Use the caveman-browse MCP tools to drive the browser: snapshot with a query, act by uid, prove settlement with a focused re-snapshot.
